name: Hushai
bio: Hushai the Archite was David's trusted friend, who met David with his robe torn and dust on his head, mourning, as David fled Jerusalem during Absalom's rebellion. Rather than let Hushai accompany him further, David asked him to return to the city and pose as Absalom's servant instead, in order to "frustrate the counsel of Ahithophel" from the inside, relaying anything he learned back to David through the priests Zadok and Abiathar and their sons (2 Samuel 15:32-37). Hushai's pivotal role in undoing Ahithophel's advice to Absalom is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
